newsitem.title: EGYPT: Cairo conference says carry out peace agreements.
newsitem.headline: Cairo conference says carry out peace agreements.

text.p: A Cairo Declaration issued by the Middle East economic conference on Thursday called for quick implementation of Israeli-Palestinian agreements and an end to Israel's closure of the Palestinian territories.

The three-page declaration also said the participants were committed to Middle East peace on the terms of reference of the Madrid peace conference in 1991 and U.N. resolutions 242 and 338, which Arabs understand to mean land for peace.

"Participants in the Cairo Economic Conference expressed their unwavering commitment to the achievement of a just, lasting and comprehensive peace in the Middle East, on the basis of the terms of reference of the Madrid Peace Conference, established by U.N. Security Council resolutions 242 and 338.

"They reaffirmed their determination to build upon the agreements reached among the parties and underlined the utmost importance of the faithful and expeditious implementation of the those agreements by all parties in particular on the Israeli-Palestinian track," it said.
"They noted with concern that the already weak Palestinian economy is suffering from restrictions and closures which hinder the daily movement of Palestinian labour and trade.
"They reiterated that removing restrictive measures and closures will prevent the decline of, and contribute positively to the performance of the Palestinian economy," it added.
The declaration did not specifically blame Israel for the economic hardships of Palestinians or say explicitly that Middle East peace should be based on the land-for-peace principle.
